Scene:
发现了夹竹桃有毒。别人看到他，很快给他吃一个灵芝。神农一吃就觉得比较好。然后，他继续写他发现的信息。会告诉他的朋友哪一个植物能不能吃。

The teacher's corrections on this scene:
- 发现了夹竹桃有毒：it is unclear that夹竹桃refers to黄色的花
- 别人看到他：另外一个人，“别(的)” is for “a different type”, and “all else except the spoken one”, whereas “另外“ is for “addition in quantity”, and “another, the other”
- 会告诉他的朋友哪一个植物能不能吃：也会告诉他的朋友哪一个植物能吃，哪个植物不能吃

The system's item in each run:
Run 1: 很快给他吃一个灵芝：很快给了他一个灵芝吃，The giving is a completed action in the narrative, so the verb needs 了; this word order clearly shows that the lingzhi is for him to eat. [rule: aspect_le_completed]
Run 2: 给他吃一个灵芝：给了他一个灵芝吃，the giving is completed, so 给 needs 了; this wording also makes clear that the lingzhi was for him to eat. [rule: aspect_le_completed]
Run 3: 给他吃一个灵芝：给了他一个灵芝吃，The giving action is completed, so the verb needs 了; this word order also clearly shows that the plant is for him to eat. [rule: aspect_le_completed]

output.reason: All runs identify the missing completed-action 了 in 给他吃一个灵芝 and make the same acceptable correction, 给了他一个灵芝吃.
